open_points.text: the request id of its create, as the caller gave it
open_points.question: For an owner-interface project creation, who creates and supplies this request id: the human owner, Registry's owner interface, or another caller component?
options: The Registry-served owner interface mints and supplies it
Registry mints it while accepting the create
open_points.default_guess: The Registry-served owner interface mints and supplies it.

open_points.subject: Project create request id
open_points.text: the request id of its create
open_points.question: Which product actions may read this fact: only a retried create internally, or also owner project reads or another projection?
options: Only create-project replay handling reads it
The owner-facing project card also reads it
Another declared owner action reads it
open_points.default_guess: Only create-project replay handling reads it.
